Keeping Up With Star Rail — Rin Tohsaka: How to Use Smartphones in the Space Age | Honkai: Star Rail
"The first step to registering an account is setting a password," the gray-haired youth said seriously.
"Next, enter your personal information," the young man in red continued.
The teenage girl stared at the screen with a grave expression, "So, you're saying that I have to input my real name, contact details, and facial features into some program of unknown origin?"
"Exactly. That's the risk you take in your evolution into a modern human being," the young man in red teased.
"This facial recognition is such a pain... 'Blink'... Which eye am I supposed to blink? Now it wants me to open my mouth?"
"Ah, that's to keep bad guys from using a photo to impersonate you... Wait," the gray-haired youth paused mid-sentence, suddenly on high alert. "What website are you on?"
The teenage girl replied without a second thought, "I didn't look too closely, just clicked it at random. I think it's called... Interastral Peace Credit."
"Never touch online loans!" The two of them hurriedly snatched the phone away.
